#### Grok Bot

# Refer friends to Grok Bot

Invite friends to try Grok Bot. They get a 2-week free trial of Premium, and when they become a paid subscriber, you get a free usage reset.

## How it works

1. Copy your referral link and share it with a friend on X, Slack, or anywhere else.
2. Your friend opens the link, signs up, and enters a credit card to start their 2-week free trial of Premium.
3. Your friend is prompted to download the Grok Bot app and can start using it right away.
4. Once your friend becomes a paid subscriber, your reward shows as pending. Your usage reset is added to your account 7 days after their payment is received.

## Who can take part

### You (the referrer)

* A paid Premium, Super, or Ultra plan on The X Subscription
* Based in the US
* At least 7 days since you checked out

### Your friend

* New to Grok
* Located in any country except China
* Signs up with an eligible email address
* Enters a credit card at checkout

Plus and Team plans can't refer friends right now.

> [!NOTE]
> On a Cursor or SuperGrok plan?
>
> Cursor and SuperGrok are legacy plans and can't refer friends. To be eligible for the referral program, switch to a Premium, Super, or Ultra plan on The X Subscription. With X Premium, you get access to all of our products in one subscription. [See plans and pricing](/x-subscription/pricing)

## Where to find your referral link

* **Grok Bot on mobile:** tap the gift icon in the top right of any chat.
* **Grok Bot on desktop:** click the gift icon in the bottom left, next to Connect apps.
* **On the web:** go to [grok.com/dashboard/referrals](https://grok.com/dashboard/referrals).

## What your friend gets

* A 2-week free trial of Premium.
* A credit card is required to start the trial.
* A reminder 7 days before their first charge, so they have time to cancel if they don't want to continue.

## What you get

* One free usage reset for each friend who becomes a paid subscriber.
* Your reward shows as pending first, then is added 7 days after your friend's payment is received.
* Each usage reset is valid for 6 months after it's added.

## Good to know

* If your friend's payment is refunded or disputed, the pending reward is removed.
* Referral rewards have no cash value.
* In-app purchases through Apple or Google aren't part of the referral program right now.
* We may change, pause, or end the referral program at any time.

## Frequently asked questions

### Why don't I see the referral option?

You may not be eligible yet. To refer friends, you need a paid Premium, Super, or Ultra plan on The X Subscription, be based in the US, and have checked out at least 7 days ago. Make sure you're on the latest version of the Grok Bot app.

### I'm on a Cursor or SuperGrok plan. Can I refer friends?

Not on those plans. Switch to a Premium, Super, or Ultra plan on The X Subscription to be eligible. See [How to unify accounts under The X Subscription](/x-subscription/unify-accounts).

### I'm on Plus or a Team plan. Can I refer friends?

Not at this time. Only Premium, Super, and Ultra plans on The X Subscription can refer friends right now.

### When will I get my usage reset?

Your reward shows as pending once your friend becomes a paid subscriber. The usage reset is added to your account 7 days after their payment is received.

### What happens if my friend cancels during their trial?

You receive a usage reset only when a friend you invited becomes a paid subscriber. If they cancel before their trial ends, no reward is issued.

### What happens if my friend gets a refund or disputes the charge?

If your friend's payment is refunded or disputed, the pending reward for that referral is removed.

### Does my usage reset expire?

Yes. Each usage reset is valid for 6 months after it's added to your account.

### Can I invite a friend who lives outside the US?

Yes. You need to be in the US to refer, but friends can join from any country except China.

### My friend subscribed through the App Store or Google Play. Does that count?

No. In-app purchases through Apple or Google aren't part of the referral program right now. Your friend needs to start their trial from your referral link and enter a credit card at checkout.

### Can I get cash instead of a usage reset?

No. Referral rewards have no cash value.
